page.overview:
Who is Polly Puddlejumper?

Polly Puddlejumper is a minor character in Cars.

"A mild-mannered homemaker by day, Polly Puddlejumper has carried a torch for the legendary King ever since he blew past her on the outskirts of Placerville one summer afternoon in 1989. Even her husband doesn't know her secret crush, and she plans to keep it that way!"
